== fx-oracle scheduling ==
PRINT Registering effect : scheduling
REGSHADER fx/sched/wide -> 1
REGSHADER fx/sched/even -> 2
REGSHADER fx/sched/narrow -> 3
REGISTER scheduling -> 1
